title: setting/house-rules.json, content format 2026-11-13
description: The core values this world changes, by the config's own sections and paths: {} for none. Each section is a patch over the core: every path must name something the core has, of the same kind, which the engine checks when it loads, so the schema leaves the sections open.

rules.description: Rules by name (core/combat.json, progression.json and timers.json).

statuses.description: Changes to core/statuses.json, by status id.

elements.description: Changes to core/elements.json, by element id.

modes.description: Changes to core/modes.json, by mode id.

dungeon.description: Changes to core/campaign.json's paths. The dungeon's world is edited in dungeon.json, not here.
